svg.title: Blue White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Blue triangle and adjoining white quadrilateral from actual source; photographic perspective simplified. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/FC.536/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
